title: Initial streaming configuration
statement: Let $z$ be a Boolean input, choose one of $K$ work tapes, and let $q$ be a state and $s$ a finite Boolean word. The initial configuration has state $q$, input-head position $1$, all work-head positions $0$, empty output, and tape contents equal to $s$ on the chosen tape and blank everywhere on every other tape.
hypotheses_covered: $j$ is one of the $K$ work tapes
